data.label: exclude
data.reason_zh: 论文提出3D世界生成的分层规划与持久状态框架，反馈仅更新当前世界状态，未修改可复用工件或形成多轮自改进。

scope_support.exclusion_quote: One world record retains plans, seeds, object identities and mutable state, boundary commitments, and edits by attribute, revised as the user advances and edits; returning tiles recompile from it.
